title: Cochain normalization of the canonical derived adjunction unit
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories with derived categories, and suppose D has K-injective resolutions [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. Let L:C→D and F:D→C be additive functors with L exact and a specified adjunction L⊣F. Write η for its ordinary unit, ηD for the unit of the canonical source-library adjunction L_D⊣RF, φ_E:L_D(QE)≅Q(LE) for the exact-functor factorization [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], and γ_J:Q(FJ)→RF(QJ) for the universal cochain right-derived comparison. For every cochain complex E of C, ηD_(QE) followed by RF(φ_E.hom) equals Q(η_E) followed by γ_(LE). Here η_E is the unit of the termwise adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy].

source.place: Tags 0DVC and 09T5, canonical derived adjunction unit; Mathlib CategoryTheory.Adjunction.derivedη_fac_app, transported from the homotopy quotient to cochain complexes.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib derivedη_fac_app to the quotient of E in the homotopy category. Expand mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app: the inverse component of mapHomotopyCategoryFactors is the identity, so its localized image cancels. Precompose the desired cochain equation with quotientCompQhIso(C).hom at E. Naturality of the derived unit moves this isomorphism past that unit. Postcompose the homotopy-category equation with RF of quotientCompQhIso(D).hom at LE, and cancel the inverse-hom pair introduced by the exact-functor factorization. Naturality of quotientCompQhIso transports the ordinary unit. The definition of rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ gives the remaining equality. These are all identities of the canonical constructions, not an existence assertion about some derived adjunction.

lean.statement:
theorem derived_unit_cochain
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
    [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D]
    [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions D]
    {L : C ⥤ D} {F : D ⥤ C} [L.Additive] [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L] [PreservesFiniteColimits L]
    (adj : L ⊣ F) (E : CochainComplex C ℤ) :
    adj.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj E) ≫
        F.rightDerivedFunctor.map (L.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app E) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((adj.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app E) ≫
        F.rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj E)
